the school system is the system that the school is a part of and the system of the school itself.The school system and school system reform are the same thing.The school system reform should be a process of school system innovation and the school system innovation should be a process that the school system changes to the school learning system.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we should establish a new school system that is rooted in epistemology and is based on the change of knowledge.

we should take knowledge as a core element of school system,consider knowledge as the foundation for school system reform,and take the change of knowledge as the key point of the school system reform.
we should make the school system adapt to the knowledge-oriented school system by means of the epistemological innovation of school system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
knowledge is the core of school system reform and school-learning system is the ultimate goal of school system reform.
we can't just focus on the change of knowledge,we must also pay attention to the change of the school system,which is a complex system with many subsystems,each of them has its own characteristics.
